instruction: An eye-level full shot of four friends playing a tag game in a grassy park. On the far left, the East Asian man in a red t-shirt with a yellow letter T (R3) leans right, holding the hand of the woman in a dark blue t-shirt with a red letter E (R4). In the center, the woman (R4) leaps forward while the woman with an afro in a red t-shirt (R6) holds her waist from behind. On the right, the bald man in a dark blue t-shirt with a light blue letter M (R2) reaches out toward them. The scene is captured in natural daylight with green trees in the background.
